name: rl-policy-control
title: Reinforcement-learning policy control runtime
description: Add a control-layer runtime for immutable trained-policy artifacts, bounded observation/action contracts, watchdog/fallback and host-qualified inference without direct hardware authority.
scope: ONNX/RTen CPU policy artifact validation, bounded non-realtime inference worker, multi-morphology observation/action contracts, direct torque and fixed-gain MIT proposals
creator: mj
notes: Explicitly depends on completion of 07-31-kinetic-arm-stack and its stable bounded profile/control proposal contracts.
